reason: Deny the authorization service to guarded desktop processes, so an updater cannot raise an administrator prompt.
insert:
;; Desktop processes have no use for administrator prompts, and the app updater
;; raises them. Kept last so no earlier rule re-allows it.
(if (string=? (param "GUI") "1")
  (deny mach-lookup (global-name "com.apple.authd")))
